text_blocks.snippet: Yes, it is possible to get reinfected with COVID-19, even after being previously infected or vaccinated. While vaccination and prior infection can provide some protection, they don't guarantee complete immunity against future infections. Re-infections can occur due to waning immunity, new variants, or other factors.
snippet_highlighted_words: Yes, it is possible to get reinfected with COVID-19, even after being previously infected or vaccinated

list.title: Waning Immunity:
list.snippet: The protection offered by both vaccination and prior infection can decrease over time. This means that even if you were previously infected or vaccinated, your body's ability to fight off the virus may weaken, making you susceptible to reinfection.

list.title: New Variants:
list.snippet: COVID-19 is constantly evolving, and new variants can emerge that are better at evading the immune system, even if it's been boosted by previous infection or vaccination.
